narratives.title: Geopolitical Escalation Risk-Off
narratives.summary: Capital is fleeing risk assets as multi-front conflicts (Iran, Israel, Ukraine) escalate beyond controlled tit-for-tat, with actual kinetic exchanges, Hormuz blockade persistence, and asymmetric threats. The market consensus underestimates the structural disruption to supply chains and energy flows.
narratives.trade_implication: Short SPY, long WTI crude oil futures, and long VIX; hedge with gold and short duration Treasuries.

narratives.title: Energy Supply Disruption Premium
narratives.summary: Capital is rotating into energy assets as the Hormuz blockade structurally bites, EIA forecasts rise, and SPR releases signal bullish supply pre-positioning rather than bearish intervention. Markets misread government actions as bearish, but actual flows indicate sustained oil price support.
narratives.trade_implication: Long WTI and Brent futures, long energy sector ETFs (XLE), and short refined product spreads.

narratives.title: Crypto as Macro Risk Proxy
narratives.summary: Bitcoin's crash mirrors broad risk-off flows, not crypto-specific fundamentals, as institutional de-risking dominates. However, whale accumulation and dip-buying suggest a potential floor, making it a lagging indicator of macro sentiment rather than a leading one.
narratives.trade_implication: Short BTC futures for tactical downside, but prepare to cover if geopolitical tensions de-escalate; monitor MSTR accumulation as a signal.
